info.name: CoreTrust Bank
info.description:
End-to-end demonstration of the CoreTrust Bank API.

Prerequisites: the application and its services are running, and the adminPassword collection variable is set to the bootstrap admin's password.

Run folders 00 to 09 in order with the Collection Runner. Each run creates fresh demo customers, captures tokens and ids into collection variables, and asserts the expected status codes. Folder 10 is manual (it needs OTP codes from Mailpit).

item.name: 00 Health
item.description: Checks the application is running. No token needed.

item.name: 01 Auth
item.description: Registers two demo customers and logs in as them and as the bootstrap admin. Tokens are stored in collection variables.

exec: // Fresh, unique demo users for every run, so the collection can be repeated

item.name: Negative: register with the same email

exec: pm.test('Session can be extended once', () => pm.expect(b.extendable).to.eql(true));

request.description: Requires the adminPassword collection variable (the bootstrap admin's password).

item.name: 02 Accounts
item.description: Opens one account per customer and shows ownership and validation rules.

request.description: Other customers' resources return 404, not 403, so ids can't be discovered.

item.name: 03 Cash (staff)
item.description: The admin deposits money into Sathya's account (support could do the same).

item.name: 04 Beneficiaries
item.description: Sathya adds Ram as a beneficiary. Name and bank are filled in by the server for CoreTrust accounts.

exec: pm.test('Real name filled in', () => pm.expect(b.beneficiaryName).to.eql('Ram Kumar'));

item.name: 05 Transfers & idempotency
item.description: Run in order. The replay request reuses the SAME Idempotency-Key and body as the first transfer, and must not move money again.

request.description: Same key, same body: returns the original transfer, moves no money.

item.name: Negative: admin uses the customer transfer endpoint
06 Transactions & statements
item.description: History from each customer's point of view, and statements.

item.name: Ram sees the same transfer as a CREDIT

request.description: Use 'Send and Download' to save the file.

item.name: 07 Notifications
item.description: In-app inbox created by the deposit and transfer.

item.name: 08 Admin
item.description: Representative staff actions: lookup, audit, freeze, flagging.

item.name: Negative: customer reads the audit log

request.description: No tipping off: flags are visible to staff only.

item.name: 09 Single session & logout
item.description: Run last: it ends Sathya's session.

item.name: Old access token is rejected immediately
10 Manual: OTP flows (not for the runner)
item.description: These need a code from the email in Mailpit (http://localhost:8025). Send the first request, copy the 6-digit code from the email into the otpCode collection variable, then send the second.

request.description: Set otpCode first. Changing the amount here makes the OTP invalid: it is bound to the exact operation.
